source.title: The effects of generative AI on productivity, innovation and entrepreneurship

curation.method: Project-authored paraphrase of OECD-authored framing; no third-party table rows, figures, logos, or cover art are reproduced.
curation.attribution: Calvino, F., J. Reijerink and L. Samek (2025), OECD Publishing, https://doi.org/10.1787/b21df222-en
curation.adaptation_notice: This is an adaptation of an original work by the OECD. The opinions expressed and arguments employed in this adaptation should not be reported as representing the official views of the OECD or of its Member countries.

evidence_records.observation: The publication surveys experimental evidence on generative AI in productivity, innovation, and entrepreneurship.
The reviewed evidence includes task-level and worker-level outcomes across multiple activities and study designs.
The publication reports that measured effects differ by task, user skill, and implementation context.
The publication distinguishes observed task or worker effects from broader firm-level and economy-wide implications.
